strapWidth.d: How wide do you want your shoulder straps?

necklineCoverage.d: How far up the neckline will be covered

backCoverage.d: Controls how far up the back will be covered

sideCornerDrop.d: How far down the cups go on the side between the underbust and the waist

lengthBonus.d: This controls the length of the dress as a percentage of the natural waist to knee measurement

bottomWidthBonus.d: How much room will there be around the legs at the bottom of the dress

armholeDrop.d: How much to lower the armhole

armholeWidthFront.d: How far the armhole will extend toward the center of the chest

armholeWidthBack.d: How far the armhole will extend toward the center of the back

bustEase.d: How much room do you want around the bust?

underbustEase.d: How much room do you want around the underbust?

waistEase.d: How much room do you want around the waist?

hipsEase.d: How much room do you want around the hips?

seatEase.d: How much room do you want around the seat?
